GT Interesting Thing (GTIT) bolts a cat-shaped economy layer onto your world: Neko Coins fished out of rivers and looted from chests, bauble rings with real powers, and one multiblock machine that trades, signs you in, runs lotteries and delivers mail.

This tutorial line walks the whole system in four chapters: coins, shimmering coins and rings, the lottery, and shop administration. Nothing here competes with GregTech progression — it is the reward layer on top of it.

Start by finding your first coin.
